seo.title: Nithinraj: The Grace of God in Tamil Hinduism
seo.meta_description: Explore the meaning, origin, and cultural significance of the Tamil Hindu name Nithinraj.
seo.description_paragraph: Nithinraj is a popular Tamil Hindu name that represents the grace and presence of God in daily life. Originated from the combination of 'Nithi' (day) and 'Raj' (rule or grace), the name signifies the divine blessings and protection granted to us each day. In Hindu mythology, Nithinraj is associated with various gods and goddesses, particularly Lord Vishnu, who is believed to bestow His grace upon His devotees.
